title: Quality Remediation — 2026-05-02/03 Audit
description: Fix systematic quality failures found in audit: fake analytics tests, weakened e2e assertions, untested Convex query logic, hardcoded backfill model, and suppressed console errors.
deviation_notes: Phase 3 (Convex query unit tests) delivered via pure-function extraction in convex/lib/analytics.ts rather than testing ctx.db-dependent handlers directly. Phase 2 e2e investigation revealed TRIGGER_RUN/RUN_STATUS are intentional tactical-ledger styling, not leaked enum values. Drag assertion replaced with API call verification instead of DOM text (original assertion was for never-rendered text).
